faqs.a:
(a)
Disciplinary actions.
In addition to the grounds provided in the Colorado Liquor Code and chapter 6 of
               the Arvada City Code, a license may be disciplined, suspended, or revoked for any
               of the grounds for denial set forth in
section 6-169
or unlawful acts committed pursuant to
section 6-171
.
(b)
Criminal penalties.
Nothing in the article shall prevent the city, state, or federal government from
               filing and prosecuting criminal charges against any licensee or person based on the
               same act or series of acts for which the licensee faces disciplinary action pursuant
               to this article. The prosecution of such charges may occur concurrently to any disciplinary
               proceedings by the authority.
(c)
Civil penalties in lieu of fine.
In lieu of a fine for license violations, the authority is hereby authorized to impose
               civil penalties for license violations to the same extent and according to the same
               standards as are utilized by the Colorado Liquor Code and any and all applicable rules
               and regulations adopted pursuant thereto.
(d)
All licenses subject to discipline.
In addition to any disciplinary action taken against the common consumption area
               license or certification of the promotional association, each member of a promotional
               association's individual liquor license may be subject to disciplinary action by the
               authority for any unlawful act committed by the promotional association.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
